@graph.name: Trinidad and Tobago Main Roads
@graph.description: A line feature set for the primary and secondary roads of Trindad and Tobago sourced from OpenStreetMap.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/tt_roads/download -p /data/tt_roads/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/tt_roads
  cd /data/tt_roads
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  curl -o download/tt_roads.osm 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter?data=way%5B%22highway%22~%22secondary|primary%22%5D(area:3600555717);(._;>;);out;' 2>&1
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/tt_roads.osm
  echo success: tt_roads.osm loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # Select proper geometry into the named table
  psql -d $POSTGRES_DB -U $POSTGRES_USER -p $POSTGRES_PORT -h gdsc-postgis-node-g2ofyeqsuupixow7 -c "
  SELECT * INTO tt_roads FROM lines;
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lines;
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS multilinestrings;
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS multipolygons;
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS other_relations;
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS points;"
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE tt_roads
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE tt_roads DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'tt_roads',
    'geom_local', 8035, 'multilinestring', 2
  );
  UPDATE tt_roads
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),8035)));
  CREATE INDEX tt_roads_geom_local_idx
    ON tt_roads
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
